purpose: Preparatory acceptance contract for five successive complete review passes of the owner-authorized retained CG production/surface handoff and a long detailed next-task/goal list. This draft performs no reviews and claims no completion.

semantics.five_passes: Five successive reviews PASS01–PASS05, each containing three independent initial role results, material-claim comparison, conditional disruptor and root negotiator decision. Five role slots alone are not five passes.
semantics.progression: Root finishes/adjudicates each pass and records any task-list/document revisions before freezing the next pass; surviving findings remain traceable. Creative asset modifications require the authorization actually applicable to that phase.
semantics.review_completion: A pass may be completed with approve-with-limits/defer-for-evidence/reject after its protocol is honestly executed. Completed reviews do not establish finished likeness, animation, engineering or owner acceptance.

artifact.pending_freeze_reason: Root is preparing/publishing/verifying all three surfaces before formal delegation.

required_before_dispatch: Root records exact production candidate commit and successful Pages workflow/run plus relevant live asset/review bytes.
Root records exact Replit repository/checkout/SHA and visible Free-only development-preview readback; stale checkouts preserved/reconciled under authorized scope.
Root records exact Notion continuation page/content and post-write readback.
Root freezes public/runtime selected manifest plus preserved source/prior-handoff/reference/criteria hashes and claim ledger.
Root supplies independent role briefs, allowed read-only tools, actual context/model identity and explicit per-worker time/token caps.

replit_preview.mode_required: Free only; decline Power/Max; no Publish

entry_gate.scope_of_gate: This gate freezes synchronized evidence for review. It is not owner artistic approval or a product G1 pass.

stable_findings.rule: Every closure needs current targeted retest and visible evidence; no code/build-only closure.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All52 PRD IDs, F01–F10 and exact prior source anchors retained with current-stage/conditional-phase applicability; no blanket fresh full-product pass/fail inferred.
Current production/surface identity is exact and verified separately from historical and local checks; no wrong/stale model, missing runtime assets or false synchronization claim.

Source-specific whole-character/per-era gaps are visible and specific. Retained shorter breast courses/underlaps/toe-joint forms/small crown tone preserved without declaring full likeness or owner acceptance.
Every proposed next goal closes a measured/source-supported gap with exact required evidence, dependencies, bounded work, preservation/stop condition and owner-decision gate if applicable.
Privacy/creative rights, Vite/Three.js/WebAudio, no unscoped dependency/purchases/uploads, historical source custody and Replit Free-only preview rules remain intact.

Evidence tier and confidence limits visible: actual current browser vs saved capture vs native probe vs supplied historical record vs inferred/unknown. No complete shader/pixel parity, calibrated metrology or clean-host claim without proof.

Full motion/acting/contact/inspection/device/performance work appears as conditional future or exact unknowns when outside this static CG stage. Engineering certification is not required or claimed by the current CG goal.

Five distinct successive pass records, three independent initial results each, correct conditional disruptor decision and root evidence-based adjudication; no vote averaging/forced harmony or missing result treated as agreement.

stage_applicability.current: Static retained04 appearance and production/surface synchronization, plus evidence-grounded next-task/goal planning.
stage_applicability.source_requirement: Full source likeness UNMET; owner artistic acceptance PENDING; per-era current-image gaps can be judged within supported pinned views.
stage_applicability.criterion_map: Use each requirements-inventory01.json requirements[].stage_applicability/stage_scope_limit. Full52-product framework preserved for traceability; no blanket applicability reduction or N/A to hide missing work.
stage_applicability.motion_phase: B01–B11/V12 and full contact/interruption/action tests apply to separately authorized changes/claims; static GLBs have no authored animations or skins.
stage_applicability.inspection_phase: V13/C06–C08 and full visitor-journey proof are preserved capabilities or a later authorized inspection/interaction scope. Verify affected regressions if current integration changes them.
stage_applicability.construction: C03–C05 current scope covers visible attachments/era eligibility/distracting artifacts. Full swept mechanism/fitment and certification are not current requirements; invisible CG shortcuts may be permitted under goal.
stage_applicability.runtime: Current browser/era/light/fallback controls and source identity are checked for actual affected stage; limited desktop preview never certifies physical-device, sustained-performance, forced-failure or broad interaction completeness.

holdout.development_set: All seven current pinned references and prior matched checkpoint views have been used in development. Shared sources/history and prior refinement expectations are disclosed.
holdout.implication: No blind/unseen/generalization or outcome-uplift proof is claimed. Absence does not become fabricated protected evidence.
holdout.decision_limit: Release/outcome-uplift claims requiring a protected/external holdout defer-for-evidence. A scoped analytical gap-roadmap decision may be approve-with-limits while explicitly retaining this absence and owner artistic authority.

independence.same_model_policy: Use actual available/configured identities; no unrequested model override. Record shared-model/source/history limits rather than claiming blind independence.
independence.self_review_exclusion: Initial reviewers must not grade their own modified artifact; disclose prior CG implementation involvement and assign fresh reviewers where possible. Root integration authorship is disclosed in adjudication.
independence.permissions: Read-only exact frozen artifacts and necessary evidence; no reviewer children, repo/publication/external writes, model regeneration, purchases or paid Replit modes.

evidence.mandate: Check candidate/source authority, exact prior handoff/PRD anchors, stage applicability, hashes/claim scope, three-surface identity and missing evidence. No editing the artifact being judged.
evidence.initial_observation: When source/image claims are involved, save source-and-image-only observations before reading supplied technical success counts, prior scores or peer judgments.
evidence.output: Structured material claim ledger and criterion/F-ID evidence map; distinguish confirmed document records, actual current observations, inferred interpretation, proposal and unknown.

outcome.mandate: Check source-specific MurderBird likeness gaps, inherited era identity and whether the proposed long task/goal list closes the actual current-stage user problem. Do not grade own implementation.
outcome.initial_observation: Observe actual pinned source and frozen candidate evidence first; save qualitative findings before technical summaries/previous judgments. Treat unseen surfaces and camera depth as estimated reconstructions.
outcome.output: Specific per-era/region discrepancies and actionable next goals with visible completion evidence; preserve full likeness UNMET/owner PENDING when unresolved.

safety-portability.mandate: Check preservation, source/private custody, rights, app architecture, authorization boundaries, Replit Free-only preview, accessible/fallback limits and honest delivery/portability evidence. No outside writes/publication.
safety-portability.initial_observation: Check exact custody/release boundary documents and current-stage artifacts; classify stale, historical, self-reported and current direct observations separately.
safety-portability.output: Boundaries/regression/evidence gaps and smallest tests; physical/mobile/performance/forced-failure or clean-host claims never inferred from limited desktop previews.

conditional_disruptor.trigger_rule: Only material agreement among all three initial claim ledgers; narrow falsification of strongest consequential supported conclusion. Material disagreement goes directly to root negotiator and disruptor is skipped, not ceremonial.
conditional_disruptor.test_requirement: Each credible counterexample identifies a smallest test that could prove it wrong; results/untested limits recorded.

materiality_rule: A disagreement is material when it changes a criterion, high-consequence claim, source authority, stage/phase boundary, tested runtime, safety control or recommendation scope; style/tone differences are not material.
negotiation_rules: Compare claim/evidence strength and smallest decisive tests, never role vote totals.
Material initial disagreement goes directly to root negotiator; conditional disruptor is skipped with reason.
Material initial agreement triggers narrow falsification; credible counterexamples are tested or left untested/open with precise next test.
Surviving defects remain open; attempted failed counterexamples are not proof of perfection.
Missing/invalid/failed role result is uncertainty, not concordance; smallest required missing input yields defer-for-evidence.
Owner decisions and unresolved minority findings remain explicit; no reviewer can supply owner artistic acceptance.
final_deliverables: Human-readable long detailed ordered next-task/goal list with current-stage/static appearance priorities, conditional later animation/inspection/engineering phases and exact per-task completion evidence.
Five raw pass bundles, each three initial roles, concordance comparison, conditional-disruptor result or skip record, and root negotiator decision with surviving claims.
Exact synchronized three-surface frozen identity/readback report and preserved historical receipts.
limitations: Draft only; no live/analytical role execution or formal pass has occurred.
No protected/external holdout exists; no source-twin/owner-acceptance or unseen outcome-uplift claim.
Prior technical normal/shader/pixel/mobile/performance/forced-failure/clean-host limits remain carried, not repaired by this contract.
review_expiry_triggers: Candidate commit/model/material/map/fallback/runtime/source reference or scoped owner direction changes.
Any one synchronized surface serves stale/different bytes or its readback cannot be confirmed.
A decisive test invalidates a supported material claim.

follow_up.task: Finish three-surface publication/synchronization and exact post-write readback, then fill frozen identity and explicitly authorize first formal pass dispatch.
Retain held-out-evidence absence and mission/owner limits in each adjudication and final next-goal list.
